exceptions.rationale: Re-evaluated 2026-09-13: RUSTSEC-2024-0436 is an unmaintained-only advisory for paste 1.0.15, a build-time proc macro used by tokenizers 0.22.2 through fastembed 5.17.2. The checksum-verified crate has no normal dependencies or unsafe blocks and is not linked into or callable by the release binary. macro_rules_attribute 0.2.3 uses pastey, leaving tokenizers as the only paste edge. Published tokenizers 0.23.2 still requires paste ^1.0.14; fastembed 6.1.0 requires tokenizers ^0.23.2, so upgrading does not remove it. Accept only this exact locked finding through 2026-09-20. Re-evaluate upstream migration before expiry; remove the exception when a compatible maintained path is available.

Re-evaluated 2026-09-13: RUSTSEC-2026-0253 requires LruCache::pop to unwind while dropping a key with a panicking Drop implementation. The only locked release use is Tantivy 0.26.1's document-store cache, LruCache<usize, OwnedBytes>, which calls get/put/len but not pop. The cache field is not exposed to callers, and usize keys cannot run a panicking Drop. The checksum-verified lru 0.16.4 source has the reported unsafe ordering, but this call/key combination does not reach it. Published Tantivy 0.26.2 still requires lru ^0.16.3; patched lru >=0.18.2 is outside that requirement. Accept only this exact locked finding through 2026-09-20; remove the exception when a compatible Tantivy release adopts patched lru.
